Engineering Controls
 1. Install high-quality mufflers/silencers on engine-powered equipment.
 2. Replace worn, loose, or unbalanced machine parts that cause vibration.
 3. Keep machine parts well lubricated to reduce friction.
 4. Erect acoustical enclosures and barriers around generators.
